## Où j'en suis
The Fernhill SAML ACS endpoint is done: signature verification was implemented with signxml (python3-saml was dropped after the lxml/xmlsec mismatch), condition checks (audience, recipient, time window, replay protection) written with tests, skew set to 120 s per Fernhill's contract annex. Code passed lint, mypy and the full test suite; PR #412 was opened and merged (squash) after Maya's approval. Demo with Fernhill is Thursday 10:00 New York.

- [prochaine-étape] Load Fernhill's staging IdP metadata and send them our staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD
- [prochaine-étape] Create a separate ticket to enforce SSO / disable password login for Fernhill users (explicitly out of PR #412)
- [essai-raté] python3-saml on Alpine: libxml2 version mismatch, and building lxml from source still failed — replaced with signxml
- [essai-raté] `gh pr merge 412 --squash` initially refused (needed an approving review); user declined `--admin` and `--auto` (source: t21)
- [décision] Skew tolerance is 120 s, driven by the Fernhill security questionnaire (source: t12)
- [décision] Only read attributes from the signxml-verified `signed_xml` element, never the raw document (source: t08)
